name: VOCE Applied Solutions
description: A decision-oriented registry connecting VOCE research on agents and LI!GHT WORKFORCE © to deployable software, platforms and infrastructure. Inclusion is documentary, not an endorsement.

methodology.evidence_rule: Every use case links to VOCE corpus evidence when available. Vendor capabilities are separately checked against official vendor material.
methodology.independence: Presence in the registry is not a VOCE recommendation, certification, ranking or commercial endorsement.
methodology.autonomy: Autonomy is described as assist, supervised action, governed execution or configurable. Actual permissions depend on deployment.
methodology.regulated_work: For legal, finance, HR, health and other high-stakes workflows, professional accountability and applicable regulation remain with the deploying organisation and qualified humans.
methodology.freshness: Vendor capabilities change quickly. Each solution record carries a verification date.

solutions.human_control: Legal judgment, exception handling and final approval remain human responsibilities.
solutions.fit: Legal teams that want a purpose-built environment around firm knowledge, playbooks and governed collaboration.
solutions.caution: Purpose-built legal product; deployment must preserve confidentiality, privilege, access controls and jurisdiction-specific validation.

use_cases: Revue initiale de NDA et contrats
fr.fit: Équipes juridiques recherchant un environnement métier autour des connaissances, playbooks et collaborations gouvernées.
fr.caution: Préserver confidentialité, secret professionnel, contrôle des accès et validation selon la juridiction.

use_cases: Prima revisione di NDA e contratti
it.fit: Team legali che cercano un ambiente verticale basato su conoscenza, playbook e collaborazione governata.
it.caution: Preservare riservatezza, privilegio professionale, controlli di accesso e validazione per giurisdizione.

solutions.human_control: Lawyers remain responsible for strategy, source checking, professional judgment and work product.
solutions.fit: Legal teams that value workflows grounded in Westlaw, Practical Law and organisation knowledge.
solutions.caution: Jurisdiction and content coverage vary. Verify availability and authoritative-source scope before deployment.

fr.fit: Équipes juridiques privilégiant des workflows ancrés dans Westlaw, Practical Law et leurs propres connaissances.
fr.caution: Vérifier la juridiction, la couverture des contenus et la disponibilité exacte avant déploiement.

it.fit: Team legali che privilegiano workflow fondati su Westlaw, Practical Law e conoscenza interna.
it.caution: Verificare giurisdizione, copertura delle fonti e disponibilità esatta prima del deployment.

use_cases: Accounting close readiness and anomaly investigation
solutions.human_control: Objectives, policies, permissions, thresholds, approvals and escalation boundaries are defined by the organisation.
solutions.fit: Oracle Fusion customers seeking agentic execution inside ERP/HCM business objects and controls.
solutions.caution: Capabilities depend on Fusion modules, release and configured operating envelope. Do not infer full autonomy from product naming.

use_cases: Préparation de clôture et anomalies comptables
Planification RH et révision des horaires
fr.fit: Clients Oracle Fusion voulant exécuter des processus agentiques directement dans les objets ERP/HCM et leurs contrôles.
fr.caution: Les capacités dépendent des modules, de la version et de l'Operating Envelope configuré.

use_cases: Preparazione della chiusura e anomalie contabili
it.fit: Clienti Oracle Fusion che vogliono esecuzione agentica dentro oggetti e controlli ERP/HCM.
it.caution: Le capacità dipendono da moduli, release e Operating Envelope configurato.

solutions.human_control: Sensitive cases can be escalated; policies, workflows, security and AI Control Tower govern execution.
solutions.fit: Organisations already using ServiceNow as a workflow and service-management layer across functions.
solutions.caution: The practical boundary of an agent is the configured workflow, data fabric and permissions, not the marketing label.

fr.fit: Organisations utilisant déjà ServiceNow comme couche de workflow transverse.
fr.caution: La frontière réelle de l'agent reste celle des workflows, données et permissions configurés.

it.fit: Organizzazioni che usano ServiceNow come livello di workflow trasversale.
it.caution: Il confine reale dell'agente è definito da workflow, dati e permessi configurati.

use_cases: Agent teams orchestrated around Workday data and rules
solutions.human_control: Deployment remains bounded by Workday data, policies and the organisation's configured rules.
solutions.fit: Workday customers seeking agents grounded in workforce and finance data.
solutions.caution: Availability and individual agent capabilities vary by product and tenant. Validate the precise agent before procurement.

use_cases: Équipes d'agents orchestrées autour des données Workday
fr.fit: Clients Workday voulant des agents ancrés dans les données workforce et finance.
fr.caution: Valider la disponibilité exacte de chaque agent et capacité dans le tenant concerné.

use_cases: Team di agenti su dati Workday
it.fit: Clienti Workday che cercano agenti fondati sui dati workforce e finance.
it.caution: Verificare disponibilità e capacità del singolo agente nel tenant interessato.

solutions.human_control: Agents operate through SAP business applications, data and process controls; material decisions still require organisational governance.
solutions.fit: SAP estates where business context is already represented in SAP data and processes.
solutions.caution: Confirm which Joule agents are generally available for the required module and geography.

use_cases: Automatisation et aide à la décision finance
fr.fit: Environnements SAP où le contexte métier réside déjà dans les données et processus SAP.
fr.caution: Vérifier la disponibilité générale de l'agent Joule requis selon module et géographie.

it.fit: Ambienti SAP in cui contesto e processi aziendali sono già rappresentati in SAP.
it.caution: Verificare la disponibilità generale del Joule Agent richiesto per modulo e geografia.

use_cases: Custom agents connected through workflows, connectors, REST APIs and MCP
solutions.human_control: Actions should inherit business-system permissions and explicit approval boundaries.
solutions.fit: Microsoft-heavy organisations that want to build and distribute custom agents across Teams, web and enterprise apps.
solutions.caution: Copilot Studio is a construction and orchestration layer, not a domain authority for law, accounting or HR compliance.

use_cases: Agents connectés aux workflows, API et MCP
fr.fit: Organisations Microsoft souhaitant construire puis diffuser des agents personnalisés.
fr.caution: Copilot Studio orchestre et construit; il ne constitue pas une autorité métier juridique, RH ou comptable.

use_cases: Agenti con workflow, API e MCP
it.fit: Organizzazioni Microsoft che vogliono costruire e distribuire agenti personalizzati.
it.caution: Copilot Studio è un livello di costruzione e orchestrazione, non un'autorità verticale legale, HR o contabile.

solutions.human_control: The deploying organisation defines tools, permissions, knowledge bases and action boundaries.
solutions.fit: Teams building their own domain agents or document pipelines, especially where Qwen and Alibaba Cloud infrastructure are strategic.
solutions.caution: This is a model and agent-building platform, not a packaged legal, HR or accounting authority. Region-specific feature availability matters.

use_cases: Agents et assistants RAG sur mesure
fr.fit: Équipes construisant leurs propres agents métiers ou chaînes documentaires, notamment autour de Qwen et Alibaba Cloud.
fr.caution: Plateforme de modèles et d'agents, pas produit juridique/RH/comptable clé en main. La disponibilité varie selon les régions.

it.fit: Team che costruiscono agenti verticali o pipeline documentali su Qwen e Alibaba Cloud.
it.caution: Piattaforma di modelli e agenti, non prodotto legale/HR/contabile pronto all'uso. Le feature variano per regione.

solutions.human_control: All domain grounding, permissions, validation and action policy must be supplied by the application around the model.
solutions.fit: Engineering teams that want a general-purpose GLM model layer for custom applications or agent systems.
solutions.caution: Not a packaged legal, HR, museum or accounting product. Domain authority must come from connected data and controls.

use_cases: Workflows de documents longs et recherche
fr.fit: Équipes d'ingénierie recherchant une couche GLM généraliste pour applications ou agents sur mesure.
fr.caution: Ce n'est pas un produit métier packagé. Corpus, permissions, validation et politiques d'action doivent être construits autour du modèle.

use_cases: Workflow su documenti lunghi e ricerca
it.fit: Team engineering che vogliono un livello GLM general purpose per applicazioni o agenti custom.
it.caution: Non è un prodotto verticale: corpus, permessi, validazione e policy di azione devono essere costruiti attorno al modello.

solutions.human_control: Editorial direction, rights clearance, factual accuracy, brand control and publication remain human responsibilities.
solutions.fit: Museums, cultural institutions and brands that need controlled high-volume audiovisual creation rather than operational workflow automation.
solutions.caution: Seedance is a creative model, not a museum ticketing, legal or accounting agent. Rights, provenance and likeness policies require separate governance.

use_cases: Prototypage vidéo d'exposition et de campagne
Création à partir de références multimodales
fr.fit: Musées, institutions culturelles et marques ayant besoin d'une production audiovisuelle contrôlée à volume élevé.
fr.caution: Seedance est un modèle créatif, pas un agent de billetterie, juridique ou comptable. Droits, provenance et ressemblance exigent une gouvernance séparée.

use_cases: Prototipi video per mostre e campagne
it.fit: Musei, istituzioni culturali e brand che richiedono produzione audiovisiva controllata ad alto volume.
it.caution: Seedance è un modello creativo, non un agente ticketing, legale o contabile. Diritti e provenienza richiedono governance separata.

solutions.human_control: Institutional teams define distribution, pricing, access, data use and integrations.
solutions.fit: Museums and cultural organisations that want a ticketing backbone with APIs, white-label journeys and data ownership.
solutions.caution: Ticketing infrastructure should be separated from agent permissions: payment, reservation, access and fraud functions should not share unnecessary authority.

fr.fit: Musées et institutions culturelles recherchant une infrastructure de billetterie ouverte, white-label et connectable.
fr.caution: Séparer les permissions: paiement, réservation, accès et fraude ne devraient pas partager une autorité inutile.

it.fit: Musei e istituzioni culturali che cercano infrastruttura ticketing aperta, white-label e integrabile.
it.caution: Separare i permessi: pagamento, prenotazione, accesso e frode non dovrebbero condividere autorità non necessaria.

solutions.human_control: VOCE's September 2026 review documented staged autonomy and mandatory supervision for selected skills, with no automatic medical-record modification.
solutions.fit: Clinics already operating on Pabau that want agents acting on the same operational data.
solutions.caution: Operational automation must remain separated from clinical judgment and protected medical data.

fr.fit: Cliniques déjà sur Pabau voulant faire agir des agents sur les mêmes données opérationnelles.
fr.caution: Séparer strictement automatisation opérationnelle, jugement clinique et données médicales protégées.

it.fit: Cliniche già su Pabau che vogliono agenti operativi sugli stessi dati.
it.caution: Separare rigorosamente automazione operativa, giudizio clinico e dati sanitari protetti.

use_cases: Task comments and closure from an AI assistant
solutions.human_control: Permissions remain tied to the user's VComply identity and can be constrained tool by tool.
solutions.fit: Compliance teams that want the GRC system of record accessible from assistants without copying data into a parallel dashboard.
solutions.caution: Retrieval and workflow execution do not replace regulatory interpretation or evidence review.

use_cases: Commentaires et clôture de tâches depuis l'assistant
fr.fit: Équipes conformité souhaitant interroger leur GRC depuis l'assistant sans dupliquer le système de référence.
fr.caution: L'exécution du workflow ne remplace ni l'interprétation réglementaire ni la revue de preuve.

it.fit: Team compliance che vogliono interrogare il GRC dall'assistente senza duplicare il sistema di record.
it.caution: Workflow e retrieval non sostituiscono interpretazione normativa né revisione delle evidenze.

solutions.product: MCP connectors for Surfer, Iconosquare and Signitic
solutions.human_control: The connected SaaS remains the data and permission boundary; write actions should remain explicit and scoped.
solutions.fit: Marketing teams reducing manual transfer among specialist SaaS tools.
solutions.caution: MCP reduces interface switching; it does not create marketing judgment or eliminate the need for brand and publishing controls.

fr.fit: Équipes marketing voulant réduire les transferts manuels entre SaaS spécialisés.
fr.caution: MCP réduit la navigation entre interfaces; il ne remplace pas le jugement marketing ni les contrôles de publication.

it.fit: Team marketing che vogliono ridurre i passaggi manuali fra SaaS specialistici.
it.caution: MCP riduce il cambio di interfaccia; non sostituisce il giudizio marketing o i controlli di pubblicazione.

solutions.human_control: Security experts remain responsible for scope, authorisation, criticality, validation and remediation decisions.
solutions.fit: Security organisations moving from periodic pentests toward continuous testing.
solutions.caution: Provider performance claims should be independently validated in the organisation's environment before staffing decisions.

fr.fit: Organisations cyber passant du pentest périodique au test continu.
fr.caution: Les performances annoncées par le fournisseur doivent être vérifiées dans l'environnement propre avant toute décision d'effectif.

it.fit: Organizzazioni cyber che passano dal pentest periodico al testing continuo.
it.caution: Le performance dichiarate dal vendor vanno validate nell'ambiente specifico prima di decisioni sulla struttura del team.

use_cases: Agent execution in legacy applications without usable APIs
solutions.human_control: Identity, authorisation, audit and transaction boundaries remain essential when agents manipulate legacy interfaces.
solutions.fit: Enterprises whose critical workflows still live behind browser or desktop interfaces rather than modern APIs.
solutions.caution: UI automation can be brittle. Regression testing and auditability are mandatory when interfaces change.

use_cases: Exécution agentique dans les applications sans API
fr.fit: Entreprises dont les processus critiques restent derrière des interfaces web ou desktop legacy.
fr.caution: L'automatisation d'interface est fragile: tests de régression et audit sont indispensables après tout changement.

use_cases: Esecuzione agentica in applicazioni senza API
it.fit: Imprese con processi critici ancora dietro interfacce web o desktop legacy.
it.caution: L'automazione UI può essere fragile: regression test e audit sono obbligatori dopo cambiamenti.
